# Scrubbin Bubbles Car Wash & Detail Center

> Family-run car wash, auto detailing and quick lube with two locations in Wallingford CT, serving New Haven County for 40+ years.

## Key pages
- [Car wash](/car-wash/): exterior/interior wash options
- [Detailing](/detailing/): package contents explained
- [Quick lube](/quick-lube/): oil change and maintenance
- [Locations](/locations/): two sites, hours, directions

## Facts
North Colony Road (895 N Colony Rd, Wallingford, CT 06492, 203.265.1982): Mon-Sat 7:00-20:00, Sun 7:00-19:00, weather permitting.
South Colony Road (954 S Colony Rd, Wallingford, CT 06492, 203.265.5779): Mon-Sat 7:00-19:00, Sun 7:00-18:00, weather permitting.
Services: car wash, detailing, quick lube. Unlimited Wash Club from $22.99/mo. Readers' Choice, Record-Journal, 12 years. Family owned 40+ years.
